name: Kawasaki KLX250 / KLX250S
engine: 249 cc liquid-cooled single, carb (to 2017) or fuel injected (2018-on)
intro: A light dual-sport. Early bikes had throttle and fuel tank recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2009 bikes are in recall 08V228 (throttle and handlebar grip). 2009-2010 bikes are in recall 11V316 (fuel tank mount tabs can crack and leak).
A-002.reason: A stuck throttle or a fuel leak is a real hazard. Both fixes are free.

G: Bikes up to 2017 have a carb. 2018-on bikes are fuel injected. Skip the steps that don't match.

recalls.what: The fuel tank may crack at the side mount tabs and leak.
